detail.longDescription:
Meet Sider, your 24/7 AI assistant and companion. Sider is now powered by leading AI technologies such as Claude and Gemini, designed to enhance your productivity and simplify your life. Whether you need to summarize a lengthy document, generate creative images, help your children with their homework, or get instant answers to your questions, Sider is here to assist you in every scenario.

1. Top AI Models, All in One App

- Comprehensive AI Access: Interact with leading AI technologies, including:
  - GPT: GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.4 mini
  - Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Haiku 5.5
  - Google: Gemini 3.8 Flash
  - xAI: Grok 4.6
  - DeepSeek: DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
  - Moonshot AI: Kimi K3
  - Zhipu: GLM-5, GLM-5.3 Flash
  - Qwen: Qwen3.8-Max
- Sider Fusion Model: Dynamically selects the best AI model for optimal responses, ensuring a seamless experience.

2. Your Reliable AI Assistant & Helper

- Reading Assistance: Summarize, translate, and explain content from documents, images, and web links.
- Writing Helper: Create and rewrite essays, posts, emails, and more in any tone or style.
- Image Generator: Turn text into stunning images with leading AI models.
- Pocket Tutor: Solve problems, explain concepts, and assist with homework and research.
- Chat with Content: Upload 30+ file formats, images, or URLs to ask questions and get instant answers.

3. Sider Claw - Complete Tasks from Your Phone

- Tell Claw what you need: Ask for research, comparison, extraction, organization, monitoring, or content creation.
- Let it do the work: Claw can research, compare, extract, organize, and create.
- Get usable results: Receive summaries, tables, reports, drafts, recommendations, or files.
- Handle complex workflows: It can work across multiple sources, websites, pages, and online processes when needed.
- Improve productivity: Reduce repetitive browsing, copying, organizing, and formatting.

4. Wisebase - Your AI-Powered Knowledge Base

- Knowledge In: Collect Information from Everywhere
  - Upload PDFs, documents, presentations, and other files
  - Save websites by pasting URLs

- Knowledge Process: Transform Information into Insights
  - Chat with multiple files for broad analysis
  - Deeply understand any file with AI assistance

Boost your productivity and have fun with Sider. Download now!
